notation: pptSlides-v2: L1 deck title (once); L2 contents title, section divider (an agenda slide that highlights one entry is the divider for that entry) and slides before the first divider; L3 slide title; L4 titled block inside a slide; repeated or (cont.) slide titles are continuation nodes. Lecturer, affiliation, course/series lines, logos, callout labels (定义, Note) are text.

nodes.note: the contents slide marks the current entry with an arrow: agenda divider; text = marked entry
